title: Weakly contractible covers within the affine ind-etale basis
statement: Let $S$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the fixed small pro-etale site and universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Give $S_{\mathrm{app}}=\mathcal B_S$, the full subcategory of affine schemes ind-etale over $S$, its induced coverings [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. Every object $U$ of $S_{\mathrm{app}}$ has a covering family $\{V_j\to U\}$ in $S_{\mathrm{app}}$ such that each $V_j$ is weakly contractible in this same site. Here weakly contractible means that every epimorphism $P\to Q$ of sheaves of sets on $S_{\mathrm{app}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] induces a surjection $P(V_j)\to Q(V_j)$; an epimorphism is a right-cancellable morphism. In particular the covering objects are themselves affine and ind-etale over $S$, not merely objects of the full pro-etale site.
